_comment: Settings for the HTML page and the daily briefing email. Edit freely.
_subscribe: Daily briefing sign-up box. Set ONE of these. subscribe_url: a newsletter provider's form/endpoint (Buttondown, Mailchimp, Formspree, a Microsoft/Google Form...) that accepts a POSTed 'email' field. subscribe_email: your own address; the box opens a pre-filled email to you, and you add the person with 'secnews subscribers add'. Leave both empty to hide the sign-up box.
